home.title: Chat with the Bhagavad Gita about your life
home.sub: Ask about a worry, a hard choice or anything on your mind, and find verses from the Bhagavad Gita that speak to it.
home.q2: How can I stay calm when anxiety returns?
home.q3: What should I do when I feel stuck?
home.q4: How can I handle pain without losing hope?
home.topics: Gita verses for what you are going through
faq1.a: An independent educational website for reading the Bhagavad Gita and finding verses on everyday questions. It is not affiliated with gitachat.in.
faq2.a: It searches the verses stored in this website by keywords and topics. It is not generative AI and it does not write new answers.
faq3.q: Do I need to know Sanskrit?
faq3.a: No. Every verse has a Hindi and an English meaning, plus transliteration.
faq4.a: Your questions are searched inside your browser and are not sent to any server.
faq5.a: Yes. The site is hosted free on GitHub Pages and needs no sign-up.
verses.title: Bhagavad Gita Verses
verses.sub: Read the Bhagavad Gita one chapter at a time. Each verse has the Sanskrit text, transliteration and meaning.
cta.title: Have a question about the Gita?
cta.sub: Ask in your own words and see the verses behind it.
topics.title: Gita verses for what you are going through
topics.sub: Pick what is on your mind. Each page lists a few verses that speak to it.
t.stress: Stress about results, exams and work
lookup.title: Gita Lookup
lookup.sub: Search the verses by Sanskrit, Hindi or English words, or by reference such as 2.47.
lookup.note: This is keyword search over the local verse text. It is not semantic AI search.
lookup.ph: Enter a word or a reference (e.g. karma, 2.47)
lookup.none: No verses found. Try another word.
chat.title: Chat with the Gita
chat.note: Independent educational assistant. It finds verses using local keyword search. It is not generative AI, not Krishna, and not professional advice.
chat.none: I could not find a verse for that. Try other words, like fear, anger or duty.

about.title: Sources & Privacy
about.src: Verse data comes from the AdiyogiArts/gita-json dataset (MIT licence). Its English and Hindi texts are credited to other authors, and their redistribution terms are still being verified.
about.priv: This site has no accounts and no analytics. Preferences (languages) are saved only in your browser. Fonts load from Google Fonts.
about.aff: This site is independent and not affiliated with gitachat.in.
foot.tag: Guidance from the Bhagavad Gita for everyday life, whenever you need it.
foot.help: Need to talk to someone now? In India, call Tele-MANAS at 14416. It is free and open 24/7.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.1: Gita Saathi is an independent educational website. It is not affiliated with gitachat.in.
terms.2: The chat and search find verses by keywords. They are not generative AI, not Krishna, and not professional, medical, legal or mental-health advice.
terms.3: If you are in distress, please contact a qualified person. In India, Tele-MANAS is 14416 (free, 24/7).
terms.4: Scripture texts and translations belong to their respective authors and are used under the licences listed on the Sources & Privacy page.
terms.5: The site is provided as is, without warranty. Festival dates and explanations may be incomplete or differ by region.
